segments.title: Chương 14: Chuẩn Bị Thi Đại Học, Hệ Thống Ly Hôn Nghịch Tập Đến Rồi, Ta Là Cha Ngươi
segments.content:
Chapter 14: My Name Stays the Same, Whether Standing or Sitting. I'm Your Dad.

Damn it, where am I supposed to find a gym this late at night?

Jiang Nian stood on the long street outside the school gate under the dim yellow streetlights and opened the map on his phone. A gym with any ambition would usually have its location updated on the map. Hmm, Sunlight Fitness Studio?

A name this tacky, and it's actually closed. Is that even reasonable?

Nothing within three kilometers. Let's try five kilometers.

After some searching, Jiang Nian actually found one. It was called Vissno Fitness Studio, 4.2 kilometers from Zhennan County High School, which meant it was definitely over five kilometers away if you clicked on it.

He patted his pocket and realized he didn't have his e-bike key, so he just scanned a shared bike and sped off, figuring he might as well get a leg workout.

Twenty minutes later.

Outside a brightly lit, two-story gym, Jiang Nian parked with the cold smirk of an overbearing CEO. A CEO with seven thousand yuan is still a CEO. Don't look down on tofu just because it's not meat.

This fucking shared bike had no brakes, which he only discovered after riding it into a ditch.

The roads in a small county town were truly bumpy; five kilometers out, and they were a mess.

He wiped the blood from his elbow. It wasn't serious, just a bit red and swollen. When this damn bike went into the ditch, its creaks were louder than his own cries.

He glanced down at the dirt on his clothes but couldn't be bothered with it now.

Upon entering the gym, he was met by the reception desk, where a beautiful woman in her twenties was standing. She glanced at Jiang Nian, still in his Zhennan County High school uniform and covered in dirt.

She just glanced once and didn't speak. It was almost time to get off work, and some brat from the county high had shown up, with no adult in sight. Why bother? Could she even make money off him?

This was the kind of laid-back attitude unique to small county towns, where people judge you by your cover.

Jiang Nian couldn't be bothered with her either. He saw a beautiful young woman in pink yoga pants in the lounge area. She wore a white vest that showcased her ample assets and looked like a female fitness instructor.

So he walked straight toward her. It didn't matter who he signed up with, right?

The female receptionist turned her head and noticed, but she didn't do anything, simply raising her voice.

"You can't come in without a membership."

Jiang Nian had already taken a fall and was here for the sole purpose of throwing money at the gym. He was getting a membership and buying classes to complete his mission; he had no intention of actually attending them.

Hearing her tone, he was instantly annoyed.

"Isn't that why I'm here? To get a membership?"

Hearing this, the beautiful young woman in the pink yoga pants suddenly stood up. Jiang Nian looked at her. She just shot him a glance and walked away with a cold expression.

What the hell, what a trash gym.

Jiang Nian turned to leave. To hell with working out. With an attitude this pious, they might as well open a temple.

But he took out his phone and saw that it was already almost nine o'clock.

Usually, at this time, any other gyms would be closed too. Damn it all. He had skipped evening self-study specifically to not waste time. If this whole trip was for nothing, he was really going to explode.

"Um... hello, excuse me..." a timid voice sounded. "Handsome, are you the one who wants to get a membership?"

Jiang Nian turned his head and saw that another female fitness instructor had randomly spawned in the lounge area. She was wearing a conservative gray yoga outfit, and her figure was well-proportioned but not as impressive as the one in the peach-colored yoga pants.

Tsk, what a foolish woman. How could she possibly attract students like that.

There weren't many people who worked out in the county town to begin with. Perhaps in the city, there were more people serious about fitness. But in a small county, unless you had a genuine need, there was usually some other angle to it.

Whatever, I choose you!

"That's me," Jiang Nian said in a steady voice. "I don't have much time. Can we talk inside?"

"We can, it's just..." The demure-looking female instructor spoke, looking a bit troubled. "Handsome, come over here and I'll explain."

Just then, the receptionist's voice dragged out again.

"No entry without a membership!"

"Fuck you, I'm here to get a goddamn membership!" Jiang Nian couldn't take it anymore. He turned his head and said, "Do you not understand human language, you fucking bitch."

"How can a student like you curse at people!" The little princess at the front desk couldn't stand it and stood up.

"So what if I cursed at you? I'll even call your boss!" Jiang Nian swore. After all, a young man has a bit of a temper. "You refuse to take my money, fuck you!"

"Do you want me to prove my funds, you fucking ****! Come on, I'll show you if your dad has money, enough to buy a membership at your trash gym!" "You... what's your name!"

"Your dad is Zhao Feipeng, fuck you, you wanna call people on me!" Jiang Nian switched to the local dialect. "My uncle's in the anti-crime office. You fucking try calling for backup!"

Jiang Nian wasn't bluffing. His mother worked in a government unit, and his uncle was at the Public Security Bureau. Although he didn't know his uncle's exact position, he heard it was related to the anti-crime office.

Le Zhi's father was also at the Public Security Bureau, in the same system as Jiang Nian's uncle, which was why the two of them got along pretty well.

But Jiang Nian usually didn't like to bring up this connection. His uncle was a stern man who rarely smiled, and Jiang Nian wasn't particularly close to him. It would be too embarrassing to actually call him over.

After Jiang Nian switched to the local dialect, the little princess at the front desk quieted down.

"The rule is no entry without a membership. Is it not your fault too?" she muttered.

That's how these princesses are. After looking down on someone, it's always the other person's fault. When they feel wronged, they go find their bleach-blond boyfriend, and when they know they've messed with the wrong person, they resort to the proportional liability principle.

"Your mom..." Jiang Nian was livid.

Damn it, he came out to give away money only to run into an idiot.

In the lounge area, the demure young woman had already come out. She was carrying a small bag, and she placed her card and a folder on the reception desk, speaking softly.

"Wenwen, my resignation paperwork is complete. It's all here."

The female receptionist didn't say a word, still sitting there with a dark expression, looking as if her mother had just died. Seeing this, Jiang Nian wanted to curse again, his hands coming together as if to unleash Particle Style.

"Handsome," the young woman stopped Jiang Nian, a gentle smile on her face. "I'm sorry, could you come outside with me for a moment? I... you want to get a membership, right?"

He initially wanted to shake her off, but when he heard "get a membership," he immediately stopped.

"Didn't you just resign?"

The demure young woman looked embarrassed and whispered to Jiang Nian.

"I just started at a new... gym."

Oh, praise the seamless transition.

Outside the gym, the young woman wore an apologetic expression.

"I'm so sorry, little handsome. Wenwen was probably just in a bad mood today. Don't hold it against her. I'll apologize to you on her behalf, how about that?"

"You've already resigned, why are you apologizing for her?" Jiang Nian said, looking at her sideways.

"I'm sorry."

"Can you say anything other than 'I'm sorry'?"

"Little handsome, I'm sorry."

Jiang Nian rubbed his forehead. "You... forget it. Apologize if you want to."

Hearing this, Zhao Qiuxue was a bit embarrassed. She had hoped to appease his anger with an apology, then ask if the handsome young man still wanted a membership, since she had already started at a new gym.

But now, it seemed a bit unrealistic.

That was fair. If she had been treated like that, she would probably be angry too. Young men cared about their pride. It was better for her not to mention the membership, lest she upset him.

It was just a shame. Hopping to another gym was already a bit unseemly. If she went another month with zero sales, she probably wouldn't last long at her new job either.

Just as she was lamenting silently, Jiang Nian was getting impatient.

"Aren't we getting a membership?"

(End of this chapter)
